name: Molehill Mountain
description: A free Autistica app designed with and for autistic people to help users notice, understand and self-manage patterns around anxiety and worry.
intended_use: Track worries and explore structured self-management ideas for anxiety alongside, not instead of, appropriate professional support.
audience_or_context: Primarily autistic teenagers and adults who can use the app independently, and supporters helping someone use it.
limitations: The app is a self-management resource and is not a substitute for professional medical, mental-health or crisis care.
Suitability and benefit can vary substantially between people and contexts.
cost_or_access_notes: Autistica presents the app as free; current platform availability should be checked through the official project page.
conflicts_of_interest: The app is hosted and promoted by Autistica and arose from Autistica-associated research and development.

provenance.method: Official Autistica project information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records purpose and access while leaving efficacy claims to separately governed evidence routes.
